Bethel Christian School is a coeducational school, offering education Kindergarten through to Year Ten. The school  commenced year 11 in 2013, which was very successful. The school is committed to providing comprehensive academic, physical and spiritual education. Established in 1979, it became a ministry of Essington Church in the mid1980s. The school continued to strive for excellence in providing a Christian community dedicated to serving the Mt Druitt area and beyond. The school is proud of its multicultural student population as they celebrate the harmony and diversity amongst its community members. The school was established to provide students with a Christian education, designed to serve them for the whole of life. Bethel Christian School fosters a family atmosphere and strives to promote a Christcentred culture within the community through having committed Christian teachers and staff modeling Christ to the students, parents and beyond. All subjects are taught from a Biblical Christian perspective and include weekly Chapel services and daily devotions.

Odyssey House Victoria offers a wide range of drugs and alcohol services throughout Victoria.  It provides longterm intensive residential treatment for individuals and families within a 100 bed facility located in metro Melbourne together with numerous other residential and communitybased treatment and support services to address drug/alcohol/gambling problems along with any associated mental health, vocational, health, relationship and family issues.
